evidence.finding: The fast-path body of the captured IR issues exactly four tt.gather ops on tensor<16x128xf16> (lines 68,72,75,79), one per (vertical tile x {left,right} neighbour), immediately before the 0.25/0.75 mixes and the tt.join/tt.reshape interleave. Those four gathers are the only data movement in the kernel besides the two tt.loads (lines 46,50) and two tt.stores.

At BC level each tt.gather becomes an opaque call to @triton_gather/_0.._2 with a broadcast int32 index tensor (lines 95,99,102,106); the source rows themselves are plain contiguous memref.copy DMAs (lines 65-73). So the +-1 column neighbour is obtained through four library gather calls over 16x128 halves, while the row data arrives by two contiguous copies.

Candidate vector pipe is near saturation (aiv_vec_ratio 0.8463 vs ref 0.3281, 2.58x) and its instruction mix is dominated by the misc class (aiv_vec_misc_ratio 0.7981 vs 0.1920, 4.16x; aiv_vec_int32_ratio 0.0227 vs 0.0057, 4.01x), i.e. index/shuffle-style ops, consistent with four gathers per program.

The memory pipe is nearly idle: aiv_mte2_ratio 0.0414 (ref 0.4701), aiv_mte3_ratio 0.0475, aiv_mte2_time 0.30us vs aiv_vec_time 7.96us per program; GM_to_UB sum 8256KB for a 8192KB input (row pair read twice) with 1054 bytes per MTE2 transfer. Byte volume is already read once per (row pair) and there is ~10x headroom on MTE2, so extra contiguous reads are affordable while extra vector work is not.
Candidate Task Duration 269.065us with Block Dim 1152 (= 128 images x 9 programs, QB=16) on one vector op _blk2x_kernel; the fixed-case latency is the whole-kernel time of this single launch.

finding: On the fixed 2x fp16 case the per-program vector stage is bottlenecked by four UB gathers that realise the +-1 column neighbour, while the MTE2 pipe that brings the same rows in is ~95% idle.
hypothesis: The +-1 column neighbours do not need a UB shuffle at all: because each input row is contiguous in GM and the flat tile address is base+tensor(range), the left/right neighbours can be fetched as two extra contiguous, one-element-shifted DMA reads per source row tile, with the row-edge clamp applied by a cheap select (IW is a power of two on this path, so the column index is offs & (IW-1)). Moving that neighbour access from the saturated vector/shuffle pipe (vec_ratio 0.846, misc 0.798) to the idle MTE2 pipe (0.041) should cut per-program vector instructions and hence kernel duration.
change: In _blk2x_kernel, only the H16 (fp16) block-grid branch: replace the four tl.gather calls with four additional flat contiguous loads (offs-1 / offs+1 relative to the two row tiles, exactly the same data the aligned loads already touch) plus per-row clamp selects, and factor the arithmetic as horizontal-then-vertical (Hf_e, Hf_o, Hg_e, Hg_o, then 0.25/0.75 vertical mixes), which has identical coefficients to the current vertical-then-horizontal order. Stores, store masks, grid, the b == NB clamped-edge program, the non-H16 (bf16/fp32) branch, and all other kernels/paths stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
expected: Per-program aiv_vec_time and aiv_vec_misc_ratio fall (four gathers removed, ~10 more flat f16 ops added); aiv_mte2_time rises roughly 3x on the load side (2 aligned + 4 one-element-shifted reads) but stays far under the vector time; candidate Task Duration below the current 269.065us for the fixed case; aiv_vec_ratio should fall below 0.846. Bitwise output equality is not claimed (fp16 association changes), values stay within the 0.015 atol/rtol contract because the tap weights are identical.
validation: Tool-bridge preflight --source candidate.py (compile + admission); external host runs the full 24-formal + 30-supplementary-per-case KGS contract with required_matched_ratio 1.0, then compares Task Duration and the pipe metrics against this paired reference. Risk to watch: one-element-misaligned contiguous DMA could be disproportionately expensive on this target (an earlier probe note reports shifted *2-D* block loads being 6x slower because their addressing left the 1-D shape; this change deliberately keeps 1-D addressing). If mte2 time grows more than the vector time shrinks, the mechanism is rejected and the gather form restored.
unknown: Cost of a one-element-misaligned contiguous MTE2 read on Ascend910B4 is not measured in the supplied evidence.
Whether the misc-class vector ratio is dominated by gather vs by the join/reshape interleave copies; no per-instruction breakdown was supplied.
Whether the 4 extra loads hit L2 (same rows just read) or add HBM traffic; read_main_memory_datas 8399KB is already ~2x input.
